support.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Both payments have cleared. Could you check the duplicate charge and help me get a refund?

questions.name: department
questions.instructions: Which team should handle this customer request?

options.text: Billing: payments, invoices, charges and refunds.
Technical support: bugs, login problems and product errors.
Sales: pricing, plans and new purchases.
Other: requests unrelated to billing, technical support or sales.

policy.text:
Policy: Approve an order only if payment is confirmed AND stock is available. If payment is unconfirmed, hold the order. If payment is confirmed but stock is unavailable, request restocking.

Order: Payment is confirmed. Stock is unavailable. The customer is a long-term customer.

questions.name: next_action
questions.instructions: Which action follows the stated order policy?

options.text: Approve the order for dispatch.
Hold the order until payment is confirmed.
Request restocking before dispatch.

uncertain.text: A customer says they may have been charged twice. Only one payment receipt is attached. No bank statement or payment processor log is available. The support team has not investigated yet.

questions.name: duplicate_charge
questions.instructions: Does the available evidence establish that two payments were collected?

options.text: The available evidence does not establish that two payments were collected.
The available evidence establishes that two payments were collected.

photo_score.text: Use only the attached photograph to rate how well the main object can be inspected. Consider visible shape and surface details, including blur, darkness, cropping, and occlusion. Apply the supplied 0 to 3 visibility rubric.

questions.name: object_visibility
questions.instructions: How clearly can the main object's shape and surface details be inspected? Use the ordered visibility grades; do not score your confidence in another answer.

options.text: Unusable: the main object cannot be distinguished well enough to inspect its shape.
Limited: the object can be located, but most of its shape or surface detail is hidden by blur, darkness, cropping, or occlusion.
Usable: the main shape and some surface details are visible, but blur, darkness, cropping, or occlusion prevents a clear view of nearly the whole object.
Clear: nearly the whole main object and its surface details are clearly visible, with little blur, darkness, cropping, or occlusion.

photo_policy.text: Demo sorting policy: Put paper and cardboard in the paper bin. Put glass in the glass bin. Put metal and plastic in the container bin. Send mixed materials or items that cannot be identified confidently for manual review. Apply this stated policy to the main item in the photograph.

questions.name: sorting_action
questions.instructions: Which action follows the stated demo sorting policy for the photographed item?

options.text: Place the item in the paper and cardboard bin.
Place the item in the glass bin.
Place the item in the metal and plastic container bin.
Send the item for manual review because its material is mixed or unclear.

photo_truth.text: Use the attached photograph as the evidence for the proposition. Judge the main object's material, rather than the background or a small label.

questions.name: made_of_metal
questions.instructions: Is the main object in the photograph primarily made of metal?

options.text: The main object is not primarily made of metal.
The main object is primarily made of metal.
